svg.title: M01 · PeopleOS — HR & payroll · Aug — Sep 2026
svg.desc: A payroll engine that handles 13th-salary installments, prorated pay and child support — and generates the payslip as a PDF. Role- and unit-based access, audit trail and migrations. 11 REST API modules, 6 security middlewares, 20+ test suites. Stack: Node.js, Express 5, MySQL, JWT, bcrypt, PDFKit, React 19, node:test. In development · private repository.
